title: LibreDWG AcDs DXF-export stage boundary
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-readiness refinement

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was already broadly modified and uncommitted. This pass changed only the implementation plan and this research receipt; it did not edit codec or test source.

sources.observation: The current mutable source calls dxf_acds_write for non-minimal R2013+ output, but its only ACSDSDATA emission block is guarded by the literal false condition if (0 && _obj->num_segidx), then returns success. The source also has a CAN_ACIS_IN_DS_DATA-guarded fallback that changes modern inline ACIS conversion to an R2004 target. The coverage report snapshot is not bound here to a specific release binary.
sources.planDisposition: Do not use current-source LibreDWG dwg2dxf as positive ACDSDATA writer evidence. For any pinned build, inspect source and intermediate output separately; a successful exit or called function does not prove ACDSDATA emission.

sources.project: LibreDWG AcDs reader and open issue #1411
sources.observation: Issue #1411 remains open and reports a named 0.14.8593 build losing modern ACIS/AcDs payloads. The public generated DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF route does not independently demonstrate that its intermediate DWG contains the AcDs section; a separate AutoCAD DWG report is confidential. Mutable current DWG-reader source contains an AcDs section/record path and queues modeler handles from has_ds_data, but that source path is not proof of complete per-build section/index/key/blob recovery.
sources.planDisposition: Collect per-stage hashes and inspect the intermediate DWG's section directory/pages, AcDs records, entity flags, exact owner/key join, and payload bytes. Diagnose only the first stage with proven loss. Use an independently observed known-good AcDs DWG for a reader claim; otherwise record NOT_QUALIFIED. The reported 5,489-byte value is not a conformance constant.

sources.observation: Current main contains an AC1032 planar-cube DWG self-roundtrip that checks ACIS data presence and has_ds_data linkage, plus synthetic marker/filler SAB pairing controls. These are carrier/link observations, not reported parsed topology, independent shape validity or analytic geometry, or native application acceptance. Mutable main is not an immutable release artifact.
sources.planDisposition: Keep ACadRust as an optional correlated codec route. A same-codec self-roundtrip is not geometry truth; pin source and artifact, and require separate expected geometry and semantic checks.

sources.observation: cq-acis starts from SAT/SAB payload bytes and converts a documented supported subset through CadQuery/OpenCascade. The existing 0.3.12 local receipt records a bounded valid-shape and analytic-metric observation but remains qualification-ineligible; it does not test DWG section extraction or AcDs ownership. CadQuery/FreeCAD Part share the OCCT kernel family.
sources.planDisposition: Use only after exact outer carrier and owner/key closure; do not count it as DWG AcDs evidence, arbitrary SAB support, or an independent-kernel vote. Reuse the exact receipt and add no routine dependency/run.

sources.observation: The current documentation distinguishes C++ and legacy Python importer paths and states that stock FreeCAD cannot read embedded ACIS/SAT solids.
sources.planDisposition: Keep explicit-entity consumer results separate from ACIS/ACDS carrier and semantic outcomes; classify unsupported consumer geometry without attributing it to libdxfrw carrier loss.

existingOwners: PAR-07/S8 AcDs carrier, owner/key, semantic, and consumer evidence
PAR-59 staged modeler-loss attribution and peer admission

implementationReadiness.defaultAction: Reuse existing generated fast controls; only add a local test if a distinct uncovered local invariant is proven.
sequence: At any selected peer checkpoint, pin exact source/build and inspect source-level AcDs read/write paths first.
Generate scratch-only inputs and inspect/hash every intermediate so the first stage of any loss is identifiable.
Require section/index/owner/key/payload closure before sending bytes to a SAT/SAB semantic reader.
Compare supported shape output with independently authored analytic expectations; keep OCCT-family evidence correlated.
If the exact independent input or build is unavailable, record NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED, complete local fast work, and self-unblock.
implementationReadiness.progressPolicy: No implementation slice was performed. Existing self-update/self-unblock and progress-after-commit requirements remain unchanged.

limitations: No peer package or executable, native CAD application, test suite, or local codec implementation was run. No external drawing was downloaded. GitHub source pages are mutable and the current out_dxf.c page was not bound to a release artifact; the issue's confidential AutoCAD DWG is unavailable. This is peer-source/stage-boundary evidence, not a local reproduction or format authority. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
